Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@medcorehealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor SIG + privacy path (DPA / SCCs / HIPAA)

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for taking our request. We're starting a vendor assessment for a new clinical feature and need the following from Redwood: a completed SIG-Lite (or SIG) workbook, your SOC 2 summary, and a short note on whether DPA + SCCs cover our EU data flows. Separately, we need to understand whether Redwood supports a BAA or an on-prem/private deployment path for PHI (high level is fine at this stage).

Can we schedule a 30-min kickoff this week to align scope and delivery dates? Procurement would like a timeline to map internal approvals.

Best,
Elena
Director, Vendor Risk & Privacy
MedCore Health

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear ask. We can provide the SIG workbook and SOC 2 summary next week and will surface a short feasibility note on DPA + SCCs for EU transfers. I've attached a draft SIG workbook with our initial answers and a SOC 2 one-page summary for procurement. Please treat the SIG draft as a working version — we'll iterate on any control clarifications you flag.

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>

Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-02T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor SIG + privacy path (DPA / SCCs / HIPAA)

Stephanie / team — quick technical notes to include in the feasibility note for Elena:

1) DPA / SCCs: Redwood supports controller-to-processor DPA language and EU SCCs (2021 standard contractual clauses) for hosted API customers. For customers requiring data localization or to avoid onward transfers, we offer Private deployment and Dedicated pools. We should call out any subprocessors and the standard subprocessors matrix in the DPA.

2) Data residency options: Hosted API (multi-region), Dedicated (region lock), Private (VPC / on-prem). For MedCore's clinical data, recommend Dedicated or Private.

3) Technical safeguards for PHI: KMS integration (customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM), VPC peering, network ACLs, and optional additional logging retention for audits. Note: enabling customer-managed KMS currently requires an enterprise contract and some infra lead time (~3-4 weeks).

I'll pull the subprocessors list and the KMS integration playbook into the shared Drive folder before the call.

-Neha
Principal Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@medcorehealth.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-02T13:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor SIG + privacy path (DPA / SCCs / HIPAA)

Elena — adding context from product/offerings:

- BAA: We have an established BAA process for customers taking PHI; it typically requires Dedicated capacity or Private deployment plus a security questionnaire review and a scoping call. Turning up a Private on-prem package is feasible but will need SOW + lead time (often 4-8 weeks depending on custom networking).

- For an initial procurement checkpoint, we can commit to:
  * Provide completed SIG workbook and SOC2 summary (next business day)
  * Draft DPA with SCCs redlines (legal review) within 5 business days after comment receipt
  * High-level BAA feasibility note (this will include required controls and likely deployment path) within 3 business days

If MedCore prefers, we can include a short mutual action plan and a DocuSign envelope for the DPA/BAA path once terms are agreed.

—Rishi
Head of Product, Redwood Dedicated & Private

Elena

Attached: MAA_mutual-action-plan.docx (MAP), updated redwood_SIG_draft.xlsx with a few clarifications, link to shared Drive, HubSpot record, and a placeholder DocuSign envelope ID (when ready).

Action items:

Thanks everyone — speak tomorrow.

Cheers,
Stephanie Nguyen
